## Übersicht

Diese Pipeline verarbeitet die getrimmten ITS-Amplikon-Daten aller vier
Sequenzierläufe mit DADA2 und erstellt eine gemeinsame ASV-Tabelle.

> **Primer:** ITS3_KYO2 / ITS4_KYO2

---

## 1) Pakete laden

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dada2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ShortRead)
library(knitr)

```

---

## 2) Pfade & Parameter definieren

```{r}
#| label: setup

base_path <- "C:/Users/user/Documents/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis"

# Bei ITS ist truncLen = c(0, 0) mit maxEE: Standard-Ansatz laut DADA2-ITS-Tutorial, weil die ITS-Region variabel lang ist

runs <- list(
  EC24_245 = list(
    trimmed  = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Trimmed/EC24_245"),
    filtered = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Filtered/EC24_245"),
    output   = file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output/EC24_245"),
    truncLen = c(0, 0)   # kein Trimmen, nur maxEE
  ),
  `3XX` = list(
    trimmed  = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Trimmed/3XX"),
    filtered = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Filtered/3XX"),
    output   = file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output/3XX"),
    truncLen = c(0, 0)
  ),
  Popa = list(
    trimmed  = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Trimmed/Popa"),
    filtered = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Filtered/Popa"),
    output   = file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output/Popa"),
    truncLen = c(0, 0)
  ),
  Buse = list(
    trimmed  = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Trimmed/Buse"),
    filtered = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Filtered/Buse"),
    output   = file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output/Buse"),
    truncLen = c(0, 0)
  )
)

# Ausgabeordner erstellen
for (run in runs) {
  dir.create(run$filtered, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(run$output,   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

---

## 3) DADA2-Funktion definieren

```{r}
#| label: dada2-function

run_dada2 <- function(run_name, run_params) {
  
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Verarbeite Lauf:", run_name, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dateien einlesen
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  R1_trimmed <- sort(list.files(run_params$trimmed, 
                                pattern = "_R1_trimmed.fastq", 
                                full.names = TRUE))
  R2_trimmed <- sort(list.files(run_params$trimmed, 
                                pattern = "_R2_trimmed.fastq", 
                                full.names = TRUE))
  
  sample_names <- sub("_R1_trimmed.fastq", "", basename(R1_trimmed))
  cat("Proben gefunden:", length(sample_names), "\n")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Filter & Trimmen
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  R1_filtered <- file.path(run_params$filtered, 
                           paste0(sample_names, "_R1_filtered.fastq.gz"))
  R2_filtered <- file.path(run_params$filtered, 
                           paste0(sample_names, "_R2_filtered.fastq.gz"))
  names(R1_filtered) <- sample_names
  names(R2_filtered) <- sample_names
  
  cat("Filtere und trimme...\n")
  out <- filterAndTrim(
    fwd      = R1_trimmed,
    filt     = R1_filtered,
    rev      = R2_trimmed,
    filt.rev = R2_filtered,
    truncLen    = run_params$truncLen,
    maxEE       = c(2, 5),
    truncQ      = 2,
    rm.phix     = TRUE,
    compress    = TRUE,
    multithread = FALSE
  )
  
  out_df <- as.data.frame(out)
  out_df$sample       <- sample_names
  out_df$percent_kept <- round(out_df$reads.out / out_df$reads.in * 100, 1)
  print(out_df[, c("sample", "reads.in", "reads.out", "percent_kept")])
  cat("Durchschnittlich behalten:", round(mean(out_df$percent_kept), 1), "%\n")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fehlermodell lernen
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Nur Dateien die nach dem Filtern noch existieren
  R1_filtered_exist <- R1_filtered[file.exists(R1_filtered)]
  R2_filtered_exist <- R2_filtered[file.exists(R2_filtered)]
  
  set.seed(42)
  cat("Lerne Fehlermodell R1...\n")
  err_R1 <- learnErrors(R1_filtered_exist, multithread = FALSE)
  cat("Lerne Fehlermodell R2...\n")
  err_R2 <- learnErrors(R2_filtered_exist, multithread = FALSE)
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # ASV-Inferenz
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("ASV-Inferenz...\n")
  dada_R1 <- dada(R1_filtered_exist, err = err_R1, multithread = FALSE)
  dada_R2 <- dada(R2_filtered_exist, err = err_R2, multithread = FALSE)
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Merge
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("Merge R1 + R2...\n")
  mergers <- mergePairs(
    dadaF           = dada_R2,
    derepF          = R2_filtered_exist,
    dadaR           = dada_R1,
    derepR          = R1_filtered_exist,
    minOverlap      = 12,
    maxMismatch     = 1,
    justConcatenate = TRUE,
    verbose         = FALSE
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Sequenztabelle & Chimären
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  seqtab        <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
  seqtab_nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method = "consensus",
                                      multithread = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
  
  cat("ASVs vor Chimären-Entfernung: ", ncol(seqtab), "\n")
  cat("ASVs nach Chimären-Entfernung:", ncol(seqtab_nochim), "\n")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Read-Tracking
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  getN  <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
  track <- cbind(
    out[file.exists(R1_filtered), ],
    sapply(dada_R2, getN),
    sapply(dada_R1, getN),
    sapply(mergers, getN),
    rowSums(seqtab_nochim)
  )
  colnames(track) <- c("Input", "Gefiltert", "dada_R2", "dada_R1", 
                        "Merged", "Ohne_Chimaeren")
  rownames(track) <- names(R1_filtered_exist)
  cat("\nRead-Tracking:\n")
  print(track)
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Speichern
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  saveRDS(seqtab_nochim, file.path(run_params$output, "seqtab_nochim.rds"))
  write.csv(t(seqtab_nochim), file.path(run_params$output, "ASV_table.csv"))
  write.csv(track, file.path(run_params$output, "read_tracking.csv"))
  cat("Gespeichert in:", run_params$output, "\n")
  
  return(seqtab_nochim)
}
```

---

## 4) Alle Läufe verarbeiten

```{r}
#| label: run-all

seqtabs <- list()

for (run_name in names(runs)) {
  seqtabs[[run_name]] <- run_dada2(run_name, runs[[run_name]])
}
```

---

## 5) Sequenztabellen zusammenführen

```{r}
#| label: merge-tables

seqtab_all <- mergeSequenceTables(
  seqtabs$EC24_245,
  seqtabs$`3XX`,
  seqtabs$Popa,
  seqtabs$Buse
)

cat("Zusammengeführte Tabelle:\n")
cat("  Proben:", nrow(seqtab_all), "\n")
cat("  ASVs:  ", ncol(seqtab_all), "\n")

# Speichern
output_final <- file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output")
dir.create(output_final, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

saveRDS(seqtab_all, file.path(output_final, "seqtab_all.rds"))
write.csv(t(seqtab_all), file.path(output_final, "ASV_table_all.csv"))
cat("Gespeichert:", file.path(output_final, "seqtab_all.rds"), "\n")
```
## 7) Figures Results

```{r}
# Read-Tracking pro Lauf
EC_245.readtracking <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output/EC24_245/read_tracking.csv")) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))%>%
  mutate(sequencing_run = "EC_245") %>%
  print()

XX.readtracking <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output/3XX/read_tracking.csv")) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  mutate(sequencing_run = "XX") %>%
  print()

Popa.readtracking <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output/Popa/read_tracking.csv")) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  mutate(sequencing_run = "Popa") %>%
  print()

Buse.readtracking <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output/Buse/read_tracking.csv")) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  mutate(sequencing_run = "EC25_600") %>%
  print()

all.readtracking <- bind_rows(
  EC_245.readtracking,
  XX.readtracking,
  Popa.readtracking,
  Buse.readtracking
)

print(all.readtracking)

results_table <- all.readtracking %>%
  mutate(
    Filtered_pct      = round(Gefiltert / Input * 100, 1),
    dada_R2_pct       = round(dada_R2 / Input * 100, 1),
    dada_R1_pct       = round(dada_R1 / Input * 100, 1),
    Merged_pct        = round(Merged / Input * 100, 1),
    Nonchimera_pct    = round(Ohne_Chimaeren / Input * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(
    sequencing_run,
    Input,
    Gefiltert, Filtered_pct,
    dada_R1, dada_R1_pct,
    dada_R2, dada_R2_pct,
    Merged, Merged_pct,
    Ohne_Chimaeren, Nonchimera_pct
  )

# noch für Overleaf Results section speichern
```
